title: Oral microbiome DNA extraction using Zymobiomics
author: Thidathip Wongsurawat

steps.title: Sample Concentration
steps.instruction: Concentrate the oral sample by centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 5-10 ml of collected saliva/mouthwash sample to a 15 ml sterile conical centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 4000 rpm for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Discard as much supernatant as possible and save the pellet.

steps.title: Cell Lysis and Bead Beating
steps.instruction: Lyse the sample using ZymoBIOMICS™ Lysis Solution and mechanical disruption.

substeps.instruction: Add 750 µl ZymoBIOMICS™ Lysis Solution to the tube containing the pellet and mix.
Transfer all buffer to ZR BashingBead™ Lysis Tubes and cap tightly.
Process in a bead beater or vortex with a 2 ml tube at maximum speed for 2-3 minutes.

steps.title: Initial Clarification
steps.instruction: Clear the lysate of debris via centrifugation and filtration.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the ZR BashingBead™ Lysis Tubes in a microcentrifuge at ≥ 10,000 x g for 1 minute.
Transfer up to 400 µl of the supernatant to a Zymo-Spin™ III-F Filter in a Collection Tube.
Centrifuge at 8,000 x g for 1 minute and discard the filter.

steps.title: DNA Binding
steps.instruction: Bind the DNA to the Zymo-Spin™ IIC-Z Column.

substeps.instruction: Add 1,200 μl of ZymoBIOMICS™ DNA Binding Buffer to the filtrate in the Collection Tube and mix well.
Transfer 800 µl of the mixture to a Zymo-Spin™ IIC-Z Column in a Collection Tube and centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 1 minute.
Discard the flow-through and repeat the transfer and centrifugation of the remaining mixture.

steps.title: DNA Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the bound DNA to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µl ZymoBIOMICS™ DNA Wash Buffer 1 to the Zymo-Spin™ IIC-Z Column in a new collection tube and centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 1 minute; discard flow-through.
Add 700 µl ZymoBIOMICS™ DNA Wash Buffer 2 to the Zymo-Spin™ IIC-Z Column in a Collection Tube and centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 1 minute; discard flow-through.
Add 200 µl ZymoBIOMICS™ DNA Wash Buffer 2 to the Zymo-Spin™ IIC-Z Column in a Collection Tube and centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 1 minute.

steps.title: DNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the Zymo-Spin™ IIC-Z Column to a clean 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 100 µl (minimum 50 µl) NFW directly to the column matrix and incubate for 1 minute.
Centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 1 minute to elute the DNA.
Place a Zymo-Spin™ III-HRC Filter in a new Collection Tube, add 600 µl ZymoBIOMICS™ HRC Prep Solution, and centrifuge at 8,000 x g for 3 minutes.
Transfer the eluted DNA from the previous step to the prepared Zymo-Spin™ III-HRC Filter in a clean 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube and centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Optional Magnetic Bead Clean-up
steps.instruction: Purify the DNA using magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Bring magnetic bead reagent to room temperature and mix until homogenous.
Add 1 volume of bead mixture to 1 volume of sample (e.g., 80 µl beads to 80 µl DNA).
Gently pipette up and down 10 times, flick the tube 5 times, and spin down for 1-2 seconds.
Incubate at room temperature for 5-10 minutes.
Place on a magnetic separation rack for 3 minutes.
Prepare fresh 80% ethanol (400 µl ethanol and 100 µl NFW).
While on the rack, aspirate and discard the cleared solution without disturbing the beads.
Dispense 200 µl of 80% ethanol, incubate for 1 minute at room temperature, and aspirate/discard; repeat for a total of two washes.
Remove tube from rack, spin down for 1 second, return to rack, and use a 10 µl pipette to aspirate and discard remaining ethanol.
Air-dry the tube on the bench top for 3-10 minutes until not shiny.
Add 40 µl of nuclease free water, flick 5 times (or until no clumps), spin down for 1-2 seconds, and incubate for 2 minutes.
Place on magnetic rack and use a 10 µl pipette to aspirate the DNA in NFW into a new tube.
Label and aliquot purified DNA into 2 tubes (for Illumina and Nanopore) and store at -20°C.

steps.title: DNA Quality Determination
steps.instruction: Assess the purity, concentration, and integrity of the extracted DNA.

substeps.instruction: Purity: Apply 1 µl of DNA to a NanoDrop™; target OD 260/280 ratio of 1.8 and OD 260/230 of 2.0-2.2.
Concentration: Apply 1 µl of DNA to a Qubit™ to measure concentration.
Integrity: Apply 1-5 µl of DNA to a 0.8% Agarose gel. Load 1 kb DNA ladder in the first lane and high molecular weight DNA ladder in the last lane. High integrity DNA should locate above 10 kb.
